Keeping the DDL in one\n// place prevents the two paths from drifting apart.\nconst CREATE_SCHEMA = `\n  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    username TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    role TEXT NOT NULL,\n    salt TEXT NOT NULL,\n    hash TEXT NOT NULL\n  );\n\n  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS combat_sessions (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    round INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    turn_index INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    order_json TEXT NOT NULL,\n    conditions_json TEXT NOT NULL\n  );\n\n  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS monsters (\n    slug TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    cr TEXT NOT NULL,\n    armor_class INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    hit_points INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tags_json TEXT NOT NULL\n  );\n\n  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (\n    slug TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    type TEXT NOT NULL,\n    rarity TEXT NOT NULL,\n    cost_gp INTEGER NOT NULL\n  );\n\n  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaigns (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    dm TEXT NOT NULL\n  );\n\n  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS characters (\n    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    \"class\" TEXT NOT NULL,\n    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, id),\n    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n  );\n\n  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (\n    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    kind TEXT NOT NULL,\n    summary TEXT,\n    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, id),\n    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n  );\n\n  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, id),\n    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n  );\n\n  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS factions (\n    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    stance TEXT NOT NULL,\n    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, id),\n    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n  );\n\n  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_inventory (\n    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    item_slug TEXT NOT NULL,\n    owner TEXT NOT NULL,\n    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, item_slug, CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, character_id) REFERENCES characters(campaign_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n  );\n\n  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS npcs (\n    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    id TEXT DatabaseSync(DB_PATH);\n\nexport function isInitialized() {\n  return initialized;\n}\n\nfunction ensureSchema() {\n  db.exec(CREATE_SCHEMA);\n  initialized = true;\n}\n\nexport function initDb() {\n
